SamPairs.meaning: matched architecture, dataset, attack and poison-rate combinations with both an Adam and a SAM checkpoint, badnet_a2a excluded

SamAdamReferenceAurocTokenMask.meaning: mean AUROC of the token-mask placement at the attention input on the Adam checkpoints in the matched grid

SamAdamReferenceAurocResidualDropout.meaning: mean AUROC of the dropout placement after the residual add on the Adam checkpoints in the matched grid

SamMaxRhoTokenMaskDelta.meaning: highest paired AUROC delta of the token-mask placement, SAM minus Adam, over any rho, reached at rho 0.1, n=24

SamMinRhoTokenMaskDelta.meaning: lowest paired AUROC delta of the token-mask placement, SAM minus Adam, over any rho, reached at rho 0.15, n=24

SamRhoZeroZeroFiveTokenMaskDelta.meaning: mean paired AUROC delta of the token-mask placement, SAM rho 0.05 minus Adam, over the 24 combinations both sides swept

SamRhoZeroZeroFiveResidualDropoutDelta.meaning: mean paired AUROC delta of the dropout placement after the residual add, SAM rho 0.05 minus Adam, over the 24 combinations both sides swept

SamRhoZeroOneTokenMaskDelta.meaning: mean paired AUROC delta of the token-mask placement, SAM rho 0.1 minus Adam, over the 24 combinations both sides swept

SamRhoZeroOneResidualDropoutDelta.meaning: mean paired AUROC delta of the dropout placement after the residual add, SAM rho 0.1 minus Adam, over the 24 combinations both sides swept

SamRhoZeroOneFiveTokenMaskDelta.meaning: mean paired AUROC delta of the token-mask placement, SAM rho 0.15 minus Adam, over the 24 combinations both sides swept

SamRhoZeroOneFiveResidualDropoutDelta.meaning: mean paired AUROC delta of the dropout placement after the residual add, SAM rho 0.15 minus Adam, over the 24 combinations both sides swept

SamRhoZeroTwoTokenMaskDelta.meaning: mean paired AUROC delta of the token-mask placement, SAM rho 0.2 minus Adam, over the 24 combinations both sides swept

SamRhoZeroTwoResidualDropoutDelta.meaning: mean paired AUROC delta of the dropout placement after the residual add, SAM rho 0.2 minus Adam, over the 24 combinations both sides swept
